input.rationale: Pricing is a fixed volume-band tariff with a rebate in our favour; there is no most-favoured-nation or price-matching obligation requiring Licensee to extend Licensor terms given to third parties, so the preferred position is met.

input.quote: During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
input.rationale: The non-solicit is one-way against us, runs three years post-termination (beyond our 24-month walk-away) and covers every Licensor and Affiliate employee rather than those involved in the services. The general-advertising carve-out is already present, so our edit only makes it mutual, cuts it to 12 months and limits scope to personnel involved in this Agreement.

input.quote: Subject to termination pursuant to this Agreement, the Non Exclusive license granted by Licensor to Licensee shall be for an initial period of 36 months, commencing from the acceptance date, (the "Initial Period").
input.rationale: In a 36-month committed term Licensee has no right to terminate for convenience (termination rights run only to Licensor, on any breach, on change of control or on wind-up), which is our walk-away position. We added a Customer convenience right on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund and can fall back to 60 days if needed.

input.quote: The Agreement may be renewed for an additional period of seven (7) years at the option of the Licensor.
input.rationale: A seven-year extension exercisable unilaterally by Licensor is worse than an automatic multi-year renewal and gives us no exit window or price protection; it also contradicts the mutual-extension language later in the Article. We reset renewals to 12 months by mutual written agreement with a capped uplift.
